what: At the center of the accent-color cover over the screen, the logo appears in .25s and grows over .5s, and the lightning pieces each gather from their outer positions (original distance table, in 1em units) in .583s and settle 1.4→1x. From .38s it flickers .03s ×8 and the vertices jitter every .035s, at .65s the piece plate shakes ±12px, then .416s later the pieces scatter outward again over .5s and vanish at .33s. The cover background turns transparent over .5s after .25s, and the logo grows 1.5x and vanishes at .33s, then fx:done

options.speed: Overall speed multiplier, default 1 — around 2 for frequently opened screens
options.keep: If ”on”, the curtain element stays visible even after it ends
options.[data-fx-part=shards]: SVG containing polygon pieces — any number of pieces, repeating a twenty-cell distance table
options.--fx-veil · --fx-ink · --fx-logo-w: Curtain color (default --kf-accent) · pieces · logo color (default --kf-on-accent) · logo width
